svg.aria-label: Sentinel AI user journey: seven stages across five roles, from the public brief to a recorded decision
svg.text: User journey — who does what, in what order, and where the gate is
Every stage below is a screen or an endpoint that exists. Nothing on this page is automated away from a person.
WHAT CHANGES STATE — AND WHAT MAY NEVER
four machines, each with one writer
· a person calls /approve — never the model
· a failed run says so, and is never auto-requeued
· no rule body is touched until a person answers
nothing publishes · nothing auto-fixes · no rule changes without a manager's click
append-only, hash-chained audit · any finding reproducible from its run
